founder_approval.scope: WCS-005 bounded runner qualification, exact-candidate preview safeguards, and subsequent governed restoration of the approved 11-path candidate.

activation.term_rule: One calendar month after the actual activation timestamp, recorded in the separate activation record.

candidate.target_baseline_rule: Bind to origin/main at authorized runner invocation and record the exact SHA in the manifest.

limits: No database writes or record edits.
If an isolated preview cannot run without publishing or deploying, stop and record NOT_RUN.

required_checks: Compare baseline and restored-candidate TypeScript diagnostics; reject newly introduced errors.
Run the browser check only against an isolated preview of the exact approved candidate; otherwise record NOT_RUN_CANDIDATE_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE.
invariants: Keep the canonical WCS-004 authority unchanged until the separately reviewed activation procedure.
Do not treat WCS-004 as valid after its recorded expiry.
No restoration, manifest rebinding, or preview execution before WCS-005 activation and applicable runner qualification.
No database writes, record edits, publication, deployment, or merge of PR #16 or the restoration PR.
No application changes outside the exact 11-path candidate list.
Cleanup only temporary resources created by the runner.
Founder runtime verification is required before any separate release decision.
